The OKL Transportation, Loaner & Distribution Operations role coordinates end-to-end transportation, loaner set and Orthokit operations, inbound and outbound activities, and local distribution to support reliable and timely customer service.

The position is responsible for ensuring loaner sets and products are accurately prepared, dispatched, delivered, collected, inspected, replenished and documented, and are ready to support subsequent customer and surgical requirements.

Working closely with Warehouse, Sales, Customer Service, drivers, customers, Finance, Inventory and other supporting functions, the role coordinates time-critical activities while maintaining high standards of product accuracy, quality, safety, compliance and operational efficiency.
q: li
Experience in transportation, distribution, warehousing, logistics, loaner-set operations or a related supply chain environment.
li
Strong planning, organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage time-critical deliveries, collections and emergency requirements.
li
Strong customer-service orientation with a focus on product accuracy, operational reliability and service levels.
li
Strong attention to detail in inventory management, operational documentation, product handling and quality processes.
li
Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to coordinate across Warehouse, Sales, Customer Service, drivers, customers and supporting functions.
li
Ability to identify operational issues, prioritize effectively and support practical problem solving and continuous improvement.
li
Ability to work collaboratively within a fast-paced operational environment and maintain reliable execution across multiple simultaneous activities.
li
Ability to maintain accurate system records, trackers and operational documentation required to support Loaner, Orthokit, transportation and distribution activities.
r: Coordinate end-to-end Loaner Set and Orthokit operations, including booking, preparation, dispatch, hospital delivery and collection, inspection, put-away, replenishment and readiness for subsequent customer requirements.
Ensure Orthokits are delivered and collected in accordance with confirmed schedules, maintaining a high level of kit accuracy and verifying kit functionality before dispatch.
Plan and coordinate driver schedules, daily delivery routes, collections, stock transfers and local distribution activities, monitoring execution and resolving or escalating delivery exceptions.

Coordinate inbound and outbound operations, including receiving, checking, picking, packing, dispatch preparation, shipment handover and required documentation, ensuring products are appropriately handled and tracked.

Act as a key operational liaison with customers and Sales, providing timely updates on product and loaner-set availability and supporting quotation and order creation following receipt of consumption reports.

Maintain accurate loaner-set bookings, Orthokit checklists, inventory records, operational trackers and relevant quality documentation, and support inventory counts, stock adjustments and equipment tracking requirements.

Support applicable quality, audit, health and safety requirements and ensure operational activities, records and documentation are completed in accordance with established procedures and training requirements.
Drive practical process improvements across transportation, distribution and loaner operations, while supporting time-critical emergency cases and applicable GDNI requirements.

r: Foodics is looking for a Head of Marketing, Saudi Arabia to lead marketing for our largest and most strategically important market. This is a head-level, market-owning role: you will be fully accountable for how Foodics shows up in Saudi Arabia — from brand and demand generation to campaign execution and merchant engagement — and will report directly to the VP of Marketing.

Saudi Arabia is Foodics' biggest market and needs a leader who can bring both strategic rigor and creative excellence: someone who plans and budgets like an operator, thinks and owns revenue like a growth leader, and still has the creative instincts to produce campaigns that resonate with the market.
Full marketing strategy and execution for the Saudi Arabia market, with direct accountability to the VP of Marketing.
Planning and budgeting for the Saudi marketing function, including forecasting, resource allocation, and performance tracking against revenue and growth goals.
Leadership of a team of three (Social, PR & Communications, and Events), plus management of an external creative/marketing agency.
Creative direction and content production, working closely with the agency to deliver high-quality, on-brand campaigns.
Close cross-functional collaboration with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, and Communications to ensure a unified go-to-market approach.
Coordination with Sales and Customer Success in Saudi Arabia to align marketing activity with pipeline, revenue, and merchant retention goals.
Deep, active relationships with merchants in the Saudi F&B community, using market presence to inform strategy and unlock opportunities.
Positioning Foodics around its mission and value — as a strategic partner to F&B businesses — rather than competing purely as a point-of-sale commodity.
A clear, well-structured marketing plan for the Saudi market, built and owned end-to-end.
Creative output that is relevant and tied to business outcomes — not creative for its own sake.
Demonstrated ownership of revenue impact, with a growth-hacking mindset applied to the Saudi market.
Foodics established as a clear leader in the Saudi F&B community.
